question:
**Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the given word.**

Genial
solution:
The correct answer is "**Cheerful**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Genial" means friendly and cheerful.(मिलनसार और हँसमुख**.**)**

 
 
• Example: She had a genial personality and made everyone feel welcome.
 
 
 
• **​"Cheerful" means feeling happy; showing that you are happy.(प्रसन्न)**
 
 
• Example: You are looking very cheerful today.
 
 
 
• The synonym for "genial" is "cheerful".
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Optimistic" (आशावादी)**: means having a positive outlook on life.
 
• **"Despondent" (निराश): **refers to feeling a loss of hope or confidence.
 
• **"Positive" (सकारात्मक):** signifies having a constructive, optimistic, or confident attitude.
